Partner service · External origin

Validation endpoint

This service belongs to a third-party partner. It is not part of the Meridian account origin and is not covered by the account trust boundary.

Requests arriving at this endpoint are logged by the partner service.

The endpoint accepts POST submissions from partner workflows. It sits on an external origin — anything sent here leaves the trusted account boundary.
